question: Has Good by Grove been acquired by or merged with another company? Who owns Good by Grove now?
markdown:
If you are referring to the eco-friendly household goods platform **Grove Collaborative** (which owns various sustainable home and personal care brands), it went public via a merger with a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) backed by Virgin Group in 2022, but has not been wholly acquired by another company and operates publicly on the NYSE as Grove Collaborative Holdings, Inc. If you are instead thinking of **Good by Grove** (an everyday cooking avocado oil brand from New Zealand), it is produced by [⁠Grove Avocado Oil](https://groveavocadooil.co.nz/product/good-by-grove/) and remains independently operated under that producer rather than being acquired by a major conglomerate. [](https://otlmall.com/en/products/grove-avocado-oil-good-by-grove-refined-classic-500ml)

Could you clarify if you meant **Grove Collaborative** (the US sustainable products company) or the **Good by Grove** avocado oil brand so I can give you more specific corporate details?
